title: Glowing cup of hot cocoa
svg:

    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFD966' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD966' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='40' ry='36' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='30' ry='7' fill='#D9C7A8'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='18' ry='5' fill='#C0741F' opacity='0.7'/>
